stemMarkdown: A shop offers two successive discounts of 20% and 20% on an item. What single discount percentage is equivalent to these two? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Take MP $= 100$. After 20%: $80$. After a further 20%: $64.00$. The total discount is $100 - 64.00 = 36.0\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equivalent discount $= d_1 + d_2 - \dfrac{d_1 d_2}{100} = 20 + 20 - \dfrac{400}{100} = 36.0\%$. Note it is **not** $40\%$.
